title: Swami Vivekananda's Birthday Celebrations | 4 Feb 2021 | Belur Math
description:
Swami Vivekananda's Birthday Celebrations in Ramakrishna Math, Belur Math on 4 February 2021. The Programme will be live from 8:00 am.
 
PROGRAMME 
 
AT THE NATMANDIRA OF SRI RAMAKRISHNA TEMPLE 

Vivekananda Geeti  8-00 am — 9-00 am 
(Monks & Brahmacharins, Belur Math) 


Reading from the Kathopanishad 9-05 am — 9-45 am 
(Swami Tattwasarananda ) 

Bhajan (Swami Shivapurnananda) (Swami Mahaprajnananda) 
9-50 am — 10-20 am 10-25 am — 10-40 am 

Instrumental Music 10-45 am — 11-45 pm 
(Brahmacharins, Belur Math) 

RELIGIOUS DISCOURSES  3-30 pm 
Subject: Life and Teachings of Swami Vivekananda 

President:  Swami Balabhadrananda 
Speakers:
Swami Ekachittananda (Bengali) 
Swami Karunakarananda (English) 

At Swamiji's Temple
Homa 12 noon
Sandhya Arati ( After Sri Ramakrishna Aratrika)
